action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.979) with moderate seasonality and unstable model ranking (Kendall tau -0.162). The weighted meta-model (w1) already adapts to this by assigning non-uniform weights across 19 models with moderate concentration (0.27), avoiding both the over-concentration of top-k pools (which scored 0.76–0.99) and the under-differentiation of plain mean/median (0.65–0.70). With only 3 validation windows, the 'indistinguishable' verdict confirms no other strategy is statistically superior, and the weighted approach's flexibility across the trend and seasonal components makes it the most robust choice for the blind horizon.
